# MemoLogs

> MemoLogs is an AI marketing intelligence platform by MEMO AI, Inc. It measures
> the causal impact of paid media, detects creative fatigue before CPA reacts,
> grades audiences by lifetime value, and remembers every decision alongside its
> measured outcome. Flat fee — never a percentage of media spend.

MemoLogs is not an ad generator and not an attribution dashboard. It sits
alongside existing attribution, MMM, and platform dashboards via API.

## Products

- [Incrementality IQ](https://memologs.com/incrementality-iq): Always-on causal
  experimentation using tri-model consensus — GeoTwin, CausalCore, and DiffLens —
  to establish what media actually drove, rather than what platforms claim.
- [Creative IQ](https://memologs.com/creative-iq): A creative decision OS for paid
  social. A 9-signal fatigue model detects decay before CPA moves, an Andromeda
  Readiness Score (0–100) rates how steerable an ad account is, a Diversity Gap
  Map surfaces unentered audience × angle × format cells, and an AI Top Brief
  generator turns those signals into production-ready briefs.
- [Audience IQ](https://memologs.com/audience-iq): Four AI agents grade audiences
  causally by lifetime value and activate them across paid platforms without a
  cross-platform identity graph.
- [Memory IQ](https://memologs.com/memory-iq): A decision memory layer that stores
  each strategic decision with its measured causal outcome, so later
  recommendations are informed by earlier results.
- [Media Copilot](https://memologs.com/copilot): Natural-language Q&A and a
  cross-channel command center over all connected accounts.

## Key concepts

- Andromeda: Meta's ad delivery system, in which the AI selects the audience for
  an ad largely on the basis of the creative itself. Creative therefore functions
  as targeting, which is why creative fatigue drives rising costs.
- Andromeda Readiness Score: a 0–100 score recomputed nightly per brand and ad
  account. 75+ means the creative mix is broad, fresh, and stable; below 50 flags
  concentration risk, building fatigue, or format gaps. Components: Diversity
  (30%), Fatigue (25%), Format coverage (15%), Refresh rhythm (15%), Signal
  strength (15%).
- Attribution Inflation Factor (AIF): the ratio between platform-claimed
  conversions and measured incremental lift for a given channel.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://memologs.com/pricing): Creative IQ is self-serve and free to
  start. The full platform is a flat fee: a $25K 90-day pilot (credited 100%
  toward a 12-month contract), Growth at $15–35K/month, and custom Enterprise
  terms. Pricing is never a percentage of media spend.

## Evidence

- [Case studies](https://memologs.com/case-studies): Pilots measured with geo-lift
  across fintech, retail, DTC, consumer tech, health, and QSR.
- [How it works](https://memologs.com/how-it-works): API-first onboarding —
  dashboards live by day 7, first tri-model causal verdict by week 5, board-ready
  impact report by week 12.
